subject: A-C-14 dest namespace not commit-state
body:
TASK: A-C-14
STATUS: CANDIDATE (not PASS, not live)
C_WT: 10 and 11 are v1.4-candidate; repo still 1.3; live R1 still 1.1. A will not merge.

ACCEPT:
- S10.1 ACT -> ACTION_INTENT [S01.7]/[S05]; no pin drive
- S10.7.3 candidate_ref 32-bit + defensive active_id_max (24 significant bits = Arty EXAMPLE, not identity law)
- S11.12.3 dest class COMMITTED_CORRUPT named (COMMITTED+CRC-fail, no roll-forward, not UNKNOWN)

REJECT:
- Folding COMMITTED_CORRUPT into FEM_COMPACTION_RECOVER as a fourth compaction state
- Encoding dest integrity as a fourth commit_state[1:0] value
S11.12.3 still says "exactly one of three states"; W9 commit_state[1:0] still names only OLD_VALID / CANDIDATE_NEW / COMMITTED_NEW. Keep that 2-bit field as compaction-only. Dest COMMITTED_CORRUPT is FEM_DEST_INTEGRITY (parallel observable). Pointer: live A [S02.4.1c] [S20.1]

NEED_FROM_C: land 1.4 on R1 PACKAGE (not repo-only). Keep three compaction states AND dest class as a separate namespace. Do not widen W9 commit_state to 4 values. 071529 live-R1 1.1 quote bodies not re-sent.

NOT_CLAIMED: PASS
